title: The Preservation of Fire at Bangkok Kunsthalle (final week)
summary: Last chance to see Bangkok Kunsthalle's long-running summer exhibition before it closes on 1 November.
description:
*The Preservation of Fire* has been on show at Bangkok Kunsthalle since May and closes on 1 November 2026.

Free entry.
address: Charoen Krung Rd, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok

title: Performative Art Project #15 at BACC
summary: BACC's annual performance-art strand, themed on equality, runs in the 4th-floor Studio.
description:
The Bangkok Art and Culture Centre's yearly performance programme returns to its 4th-floor Studio with works on the theme of equality, including pieces on womanhood and identity and a multimedia sound-art work on social inequality in Thailand.

The Studio also hosts part of the Bangkok Theatre Festival 2026. Prices vary by performance.
address: 939 Rama 1 Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

title: Giving Life at Dib Bangkok
summary: A major exhibition at Dib Bangkok, the city's new contemporary art museum.
description:
Dib Bangkok presents *Giving Life*, running from late September 2026 into May 2027.

Tickets range from B150 to B700.

title: STILL : ON at River City Bangkok
summary: A free exhibition in RCB Galleria 5 at the riverside art and antiques centre.
description:
River City Bangkok shows *STILL : ON* in its RCB Galleria 5 space until mid-November.

Free entry; combine it with the antique galleries and riverside views at the Si Phraya pier complex.
address: 23 Trok Rongnamkhaeng, Yota Rd, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok

title: Fortune Teller by Julie Stephen Chheng at One Bangkok
summary: An exhibition by French artist Julie Stephen Chheng at One Bangkok, closing mid-November.
description:
One Bangkok hosts *Fortune Teller*, an exhibition by artist Julie Stephen Chheng, from 2 October to 15 November 2026.

See One Bangkok's What's Happening page for location details within the district.
address: Wireless Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

title: And Still, Another After at Jim Thompson Art Center
summary: A long-running exhibition at the Jim Thompson Art Center and William Warren Library.
description:
The Jim Thompson Art Center presents *And Still, Another After*, an exhibition spread across the art center and the William Warren Library next to the Jim Thompson House.

Free entry; the show runs until late March 2027.
venue_name: Jim Thompson Art Center and William Warren Library
address: 6 Soi Kasemsan 2, Rama 1 Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

title: At the Threshold: Trey Hurst at Play Art House
summary: A solo show of layered figurative paintings by Trey Hurst on Song Wat Road.
description:
Trey Hurst's paintings from 2023-2026 show human figures that sit somewhere between abstraction and recognition, exploring memory, relationships and the passing of time.

Open Tuesday-Thursday 10:00-17:00 and Friday-Sunday 10:00-18:00; closed Mondays. Free entry.
address: 993 Song Wat Rd, Chakkawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100

title: Bright at Midnight at Bangkok Kunsthalle
summary: A new exhibition at Bangkok Kunsthalle, the art space in a former printing house in Chinatown.
description:
Bangkok Kunsthalle opens *Bright at Midnight*, running through the cool season into January.

The venue occupies a former printing house on the edge of Chinatown and is free to visit.
address: Charoen Krung Rd, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok

title: The Night by Amazing Thailand Season 2: Harmony of Healing
summary: A free evening festival in Lumphini Park mixing live music with sound healing, yoga and wellness talks.
description:
TAT's 12-night festival on the lawns by Lumphini's Entertainment Building pairs more than 46 music acts with a wellness programme: sound and scent therapy, handpan sound healing, yoga, wellness talks, DIY workshops and limited free massages.

Open 16:00-21:30 nightly until 27 October; free entry. MRT Lumphini, exits 2 or 3.
address: Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

title: Has anyone ever asked you where the wind comes from? at 100 Tonson Foundation
summary: A free, six-month exhibition at the 100 Tonson Foundation off Lang Suan.
description:
100 Tonson Foundation presents *Has anyone ever asked you where the wind comes from?*, running from mid-October 2026 to April 2027.

Free entry.
address: Soi Ton Son, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

title: Book Expo Thailand 2026 (31st National Book Expo)
summary: Thailand's big autumn book fair fills three QSNCC halls for ten days under the theme "Unread Messages".
description:
The 31st Book Expo Thailand returns to Queen Sirikit National Convention Center with publishers and booksellers across seven zones, from general books and fiction to comics, BL titles, children's and educational books, second-hand books and a foreign-language section.

The March edition of the national fair drew well over a million visitors, so expect crowds at weekends. Open daily 10:00-21:00 in Halls 5-7 on the LG level.
address: 60 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110
organizer: Publishers and Booksellers Association of Thailand (PUBAT)

title: Baanlaesuan Fair Living Festival 2026
summary: Thailand's big home-and-living fair fills two IMPACT Challenger halls for ten days.
description:
Baanlaesuan Fair brings together furniture, home and garden, outdoor living, building materials, art and food under one roof, making it a shopping trip for anyone furnishing a home.

Open 10:00-21:00 daily; free entry.
address: 99 Popular Rd, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi 11120

title: To Hold, To Be Held at Atelier 9
summary: A free gallery show running from late October to just before Christmas.
description:
Atelier 9 hosts *To Hold, To Be Held*, open from 24 October to 20 December 2026.

Free entry.

title: Chatuchak Weekend Market
summary: Bangkok's huge weekend market, with thousands of stalls selling everything from vintage to plants and street food.
description:
Chatuchak draws more than 200,000 people every weekend to its maze of sections covering clothing, crafts, homeware, antiques, pets, plants and food.

The whole market is open Saturday and Sunday 09:00-18:00. The plant section opens Wednesday and Thursday (07:00-18:00) and Friday night is wholesale only. Take BTS Mo Chit or MRT Chatuchak Park / Kamphaeng Phet.
address: Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900

title: Talad Rot Fai Srinakarin (Train Night Market)
summary: Bangkok's original retro night market behind Seacon Square, packed with vintage goods, food and warehouse bars.
description:
The Srinakarin train market is the place for vintage furniture, retro clothing, toys and classic cars, with food stalls and bars in old warehouses.

Open Thursday to Sunday from about 17:00 to midnight; it is busiest after 19:00 and at weekends. Free entry; bring cash. There is no nearby rail station, so take a taxi to Seacon Square.
address: Srinakarin Soi 51 (behind Seacon Square), Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250

title: Jodd Fairs Ratchada Night Market
summary: A nightly street-food and shopping market beside MRT Thailand Cultural Centre.
description:
Jodd Fairs moved to its Ratchadaphisek Road site next to Big C Place Ratchada in July 2025, keeping its mix of street food, bars and fashion stalls.

Open daily 17:00-01:00; most stalls are set up by 18:00. MRT Thailand Cultural Centre, Exit 4, about 100m away.
address: Ratchadaphisek Rd (next to Big C Place Ratchada), Bangkok

title: Wat Banthat Thong Festival: Pacha Taek
summary: A week-long temple fair on Banthat Thong Road, one of Bangkok's best-known food streets.
description:
The Wat Banthat Thong temple fair sets up in front of Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park with food stalls, games and stage shows under the "Pacha Taek" theme.

Come hungry; Banthat Thong Road's own restaurants are a short walk away.
venue_name: Banthat Thong Road (in front of Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park)
address: Banthat Thong Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

title: Rajadamnern Knockout Weeknight Fights
summary: Monday, Tuesday and Friday evening Knockout muay thai cards at Rajadamnern Stadium.
description:
The Knockout promotion runs shorter evening cards at Rajadamnern three nights a week, from about 19:00 to 21:00.

A cheaper and less crowded way to see stadium muay thai than the Saturday RWS show.
address: 1 Ratchadamnoen Nok Rd, Bangkok

title: SongCraft Craft Drinks Festival 2026
summary: Six days of Thai craft beer, cider and local spirits from 30+ booths at centralwOrld, free to enter.
description:
SongCraft fills centralwOrld's Eden courtyard with more than 30 booths serving Thai craft beer, cider and local spirits, plus food, live music and DJs.

The area is covered, so rain is no problem. Free entry.
address: 999/9 Rama 1 Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

title: Muse: Beyond Human (Picasso and Matisse at Dib26)
summary: A free four-day show led by a Picasso and a Matisse, part of the Bangkok Art Biennale collateral programme.
description:
Dib Bangkok, with support from Christie's, shows Pablo Picasso's *Nu couché et musicien* (1967) and Henri Matisse's *Femme en costume oriental* (1920) alongside contemporary works by Peihang Benoit, Natee Utarit and Dana Schutz.

The exhibition looks at the idea of the muse and how portraiture reveals the artist as much as the sitter. Free entry, 10:00-19:00 daily.
address: 59/44 Sukhumvit Soi 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok

title: Tuesday Social Americano at No Drama Padel
summary: Weekly evening americano for beginners to low-intermediate players at the riverside No Drama Padel club.
description:
A relaxed rotating-partner americano held every Tuesday evening, aimed at players rated roughly 1.5 to 2.6.

No Drama Padel sits on the Thonburi side of the river in Khlong San and is known for its beginner-friendly programming. Sign up through Playtomic; spots are capped.
address: 14 Charoen Nakhon 19 Alley, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok

title: Wall Whackers Americano at Pad Thai Padel
summary: Weekly Tuesday americano at Pad Thai Padel for intermediate players and up.
description:
Pad Thai Padel near Thong Lo runs a busy community calendar, and Wall Whackers is its regular Tuesday evening americano for players rated around 2.1 and above.

Booking is handled through The Padel Society app.
address: Near BTS Thong Lo, Bangkok

title: James Suckling Great Wines of the World Bangkok 2026
summary: A big walk-around wine tasting with 120 producers pouring more than 220 wines.
description:
Wine critic James Suckling's touring tasting comes to the Grand Hyatt Erawan, with around 120 producers from 30 regions pouring more than 220 wines.

Starts 17:00. General admission (B1,699) has sold out; a waitlist is open.
address: 494 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

title: One Oktoberfest 2026 at One Bangkok
summary: Five nights of beer, German-style food and Thai headliners in One Bangkok Park.
description:
One Bangkok's Oktoberfest opens with a ceremonial keg tapping at 18:00 on 28 October, then runs nightly with 34+ food vendors, 20+ drink brands, long-table seating and concerts from 19:00 to 23:00. Acts include The Paradise Bangkok, Landokmai, Phum Viphurit (31 Oct) and Burin.

Entry is B200 per day and includes a B200 food-and-drink credit. Alcohol for ages 20+.
address: Wireless Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

title: ProductTank Bangkok: Casual Drinks & Networking
summary: An informal evening for product managers, UX designers and founders near BTS Ekkamai.
description:
ProductTank's Bangkok chapter meets over food and drinks to talk product management in the AI era, UX research, remote teams and go-to-market across Southeast Asia, with an iPad on hand for impromptu demos.

18:00-21:00, upstairs at Counting Sheep Corner, a six-minute walk from BTS Ekkamai Exit 1.
address: 26/1 Sukhumvit 61, Watthana, Bangkok

title: Patron presents Henry Saiz at Sing Sing Theater
summary: Spanish melodic house DJ Henry Saiz plays Sing Sing Theater.
description: Henry Saiz, known for his live band and melodic house sets, plays a Wednesday night at Sing Sing Theater, the Shanghai-styled club on Sukhumvit.
address: Sukhumvit Soi 45, Khlong Toei Nuea, Bangkok

title: Bangkok Art Biennale 2026: Angels and Mara
summary: The fifth Bangkok Art Biennale spreads contemporary art across temples, museums and malls for four months.
description:
The fifth edition of the Bangkok Art Biennale takes the theme **Angels and Mara**, drawing on Buddhist cosmology to explore hope, protection and the darker forces that test us.

Works by Thai and international artists are installed across the city, with venues including Wat Pho, Wat Arun, Wat Prayoon, the National Museum, Museum Siam, Silpakorn Art Center, BACC, One Bangkok, centralwOrld and Siam Paragon. A symposium is scheduled for 30 October 2026.
venue_name: Citywide (Wat Pho, Wat Arun, BACC, Museum Siam and more)

title: Jason Mraz Live in Bangkok 2026
summary: Singer-songwriter Jason Mraz plays BITEC Live in Bang Na as part of his 2026 Asia tour.
description:
The Grammy-winning singer-songwriter returns to Bangkok with an evening of acoustic-leaning pop and his best-known hits.

The show takes place at BITEC Live, the concert hall inside the BITEC convention complex in Bang Na.
address: BITEC, 88 Bang Na-Trat Rd, Bang Na, Bangkok

title: Thailand Billiards Expo 2026
summary: Trade and consumer expo for billiards and snooker equipment at IMPACT Muang Thong Thani.
description:
A three-day expo for cue sports, covering tables, cues and equipment from regional brands, held at IMPACT Muang Thong Thani just north of Bangkok.

Opening hours and admission details were not published on the venue page at the time of research.
address: 47/569 Popular 3 Rd, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi

title: Makro Horeca 2026
summary: Makro's free food-business show with ingredients, kitchen kit, chef demos and 200+ food vendors.
description:
The 19th edition of Makro's food business exhibition spreads over three IMPACT halls with ingredients, kitchen equipment, chef demonstrations and more than 200 food vendors.

Aimed at restaurant owners but fun for home cooks too. Open 10:00-19:00; free entry.
address: 99 Popular Rd, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi 11120

title: BKK/hack Monthly: When LLMs Build the System
summary: BKK/hack's monthly meetup for coders and makers, with a talk on structural defences against unconstrained AI.
description:
This month Ben Scherrey of BiggestLab talks about architectural styles for keeping asynchronous, bot-built systems secure. BKK/hack meets monthly for coders, makers and learners.

18:30-21:30 at Liberty Plaza, Thong Lo; pizza from BiggestLab.
address: 40 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110

title: AI & Beers #10: Real AI Talks
summary: A casual drinks meetup for people using and building with AI: no presentations, no pitches.
description:
The tenth AI & Beers gathers beginners and experienced builders to swap notes on Claude/Codex, AI agents, automations and workflows over drinks.

19:00-21:00 at W District, Phra Khanong.
address: Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok

title: BOSS PADEL Thursday Americano at Bel Club 22
summary: Late-evening Thursday americano at Bel Club 22 on New Phetchaburi Road.
description:
Bel Club 22 hosts a weekly late-night americano on Thursdays at 21:00 for players around 1.9 to 4.0.

The club has a courtside bar and floodlit courts; sign-ups run through Padel Mates and Playtomic.
address: 1938 New Petchaburi Road, Bangkok

title: ONE Friday Fights at Lumpinee
summary: ONE Championship's weekly Friday muay thai and MMA card at Lumpinee Stadium.
description:
ONE Friday Fights is a weekly fixture at Lumpinee Boxing Stadium. ONE's calendar lists Friday Fights 176 on 30 October, followed by 177 (6 Nov), 178 (13 Nov) and 179 (20 Nov), with further numbered cards to come.

Cards are mostly muay thai with a few MMA bouts. Start time has varied between 18:30 and 19:30, so check the card before you go.
address: 6 Ram Intra Rd, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok

title: gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026
summary: Southeast Asia's biggest games fair, with playable demos, esports stages, cosplay and creator meet-ups.
description:
gamescom asia teams up with the Thailand Game Show at QSNCC for publisher booths, playable demos, esports, cosplay and creator meet-ups. Thursday 29 October is trade-only; public days are 30 October to 1 November, 10:00-19:00.

One-day passes from B200; a B300 Fast Pass gives earlier entry.
venue_name: QSNCC, Plenary Hall and Exhibition Halls 1-4
address: 60 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110

title: Padel & Drink Starter Night at Kross Padel On Nut
summary: Friday-evening beginner padel session with drinks at Kross Padel On Nut.
description:
Kross On Nut runs a weekly Friday "Padel & Drink" series split by level; the Starter session is pitched at newer players (roughly 0 to 2).

Booking is through the Kross Book & Go system. On 30 October there are additional Halloween-edition sessions at 21:00.
address: Soi Chinnamat 89/1, Phra Khanong, Bangkok

title: Halloween Night Party at Sunshine Padel
summary: A Halloween-themed evening of padel and party at Sunshine Padel Bangkok.
description:
Sunshine Padel in Bang Na marks Halloween with a themed night session open to players from level 2 upward.

Costumes are in the spirit of the evening; register through Playtomic.
address: 30 Soi Bang Na-Trat 2, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok

title: Halloween Horror Run 2026
summary: An evening 3 km costume fun run at Chulalongkorn University Stadium with a 90s Thai ghost-comic theme.
description:
A Halloween night fun run organised by the Chulalongkorn University Sports Center with Young Sons. The theme revives the cheap one-baht ghost comics many Thais grew up with, and there is a costume contest with cash prizes.

Bib pickup runs 16:00-19:00, the 3 km run flags off at 19:30 with a 21:00 cut-off.
organizer: Chulalongkorn University Sports Center x Young Sons

title: Burning City Bangkok Halloween
summary: Two-night Halloween party across 24 BLVD, Upper House, House of Savoy and Baccarat.
description:
Burning City takes over a cluster of Sukhumvit venues across Halloween weekend, with around 90 DJs on the bill over two nights, from house and techno to bass.

Tickets are sold through Ticketmelon.
venue_name: 24 BLVD, Upper House, House of Savoy & Baccarat

title: Parity: Telephones, DJ Fett Burger, Brent Burns
summary: Bar Temp hosts a deep house night with Telephones and DJ Fett Burger.
description: Chinatown listening bar Bar Temp hosts Norway's Telephones and DJ Fett Burger, with Brent Burns, for a night of loose, warm house music.

title: Sacristy Bangkok Halloween (Night 1)
summary: Dark-room electronic Halloween night at DUAL in Silom.
description: Sacristy runs the first of two Halloween nights at DUAL in Silom, a dark, heavy electronic party. Doors open at 9pm.

title: Friday Open Play at Baan Padel
summary: Weekly all-levels late-night open play at Baan Padel on Sukhumvit 67.
description:
Baan Padel, an indoor air-conditioned venue with seven courts, opens its courts for an all-levels open play session every Friday at 21:00.

Book on Playtomic; the listed price was 500 THB on 30 October and 700 THB for the November sessions.
address: 14 Soi Sukhumvit 67, Bangkok

title: DEKA FIT Bangkok 2026
summary: Thailand's first DEKA FIT: a 5 km run broken up by 10 functional fitness zones, held at Siam Paragon.
description:
Spartan's DEKA FIT format arrives in Thailand for the first time. Athletes run 5 km in total, stopping at 10 fitness zones (rowing, sled, carries and the like) along the way; the average finish is around 50 minutes.

The event runs over the weekend at Siam Paragon and is pitched at every level from first-timers to competitive hybrid athletes.
address: 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

title: Ultra Park Run Thailand 100 #7: 24H Bangkok International Championships 2026
summary: A 24-hour park ultra in Rot Fai Park, with 100K, 50K, relay and short-distance options.
description:
The seventh Ultra Park Run Thailand 100 doubles as the 24H Bangkok International Championships, run on loops through Wachirabenchathat (Rot Fai) Park with support from the Athletics Association of Thailand.

Besides the 24-hour race there are 100K, 100K relay, 50K, 10K and 5K categories. Registration has closed, but spectators can cheer the ultra runners through the day and night.
address: Kamphaeng Phet 3 Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok
organizer: Ultra Park Run Thailand x Miracle of Life Foundation

title: KANOMTHAI Exchange
summary: Bring a Thai dessert, swap it with others and fill a cake box at a canalside house facing Wat Paknam's Big Buddha.
description:
This Thai-sweets swap at Haus of Thura invites guests to bring a favourite dessert to trade, with local dessert shops joining in. Extras include a hand-fan workshop, giveaways and live music.

Two sessions, 15:00-18:00 on 31 October and 1 November. B550 per day; check booking terms for what to bring.
address: 21 Phet Kasem 19 Alley, Bangkok

title: DIAGE Festival 2026: Bangkok Calling
summary: Two-day electronic and audiovisual festival returns to Cloud 11 with Evian Christ, NONOTAK, Tzusing and more.
description:
DIAGE returns after a year off with a two-day edition spread across a main stage, an audiovisual stage, a DJ stage and an exhibition zone at Cloud 11 near Phra Khanong.

The announced bill mixes international experimental electronic names such as Evian Christ, Slikback and Tzusing with Thai and regional acts. Evening programming is 20+.
address: Sukhumvit Rd, near Phra Khanong, Bangkok
price_text: Two-day passes from B1,990 (early bird) to B3,890

title: The Music Run Bangkok 2026
summary: An untimed 5 km evening fun run with music along the whole route at Suan Luang Rama IX, followed by a party.
description:
The Music Run puts speakers along a 5 km loop so runners, walkers and dancers move to playlists the whole way. Waves start from 16:15 (fast, chill and fun paces).

After the run the Live The Beat festival continues in the park until 21:00. Gates open at 15:00.
address: Suan Luang Rama IX, Prawet, Bangkok

title: Clutch Halloween Party with Baldo
summary: Deep house and acid Halloween night at Clutch in The Warehouse, Talat Noi.
description: Clutch, inside The Warehouse in Talat Noi, hosts Baldo for a deep house and acid Halloween party running from 6pm to 3am.

title: Ghost Boat Halloween Cruise
summary: Halloween party boat on the Chao Phraya with an after-party until 1am.
description: Boarding starts at 6pm and the boat sails at 8pm for a Halloween cruise on the Chao Phraya. It docks around 11pm, and the party continues ashore at Bangkok Island until 1am.

title: Padel Tribe Mexicano Halloween Spooky Party
summary: Halloween mexicano party hosted by the Padel Tribe community at Baan Padel's soft-opening venue.
description:
The Padel Tribe community group throws a Halloween mexicano for players around level 1.6 to 3.6. The listing places it at a Baan Padel venue in soft opening.

Check the booking listing for the exact location before heading out.

title: NCT 127 5th Tour 'NEO CITY: BANGKOK - THE REDLINE'
summary: NCT 127 celebrate ten years with two stadium nights at Thammasat Stadium in Rangsit.
description:
SM Entertainment's NCT 127 bring their fifth world tour, The Redline, to Thammasat Stadium for two evening shows.

The stadium is at Thammasat University's Rangsit campus in Pathum Thani, just north of Bangkok. Both shows start at 7pm.
address: Thammasat University Rangsit Campus, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani

title: Beginner Americano & Sangria at Kross Padel Asoke
summary: Saturday-night beginner americano with sangria at the central Kross Asoke branch.
description:
A weekly Saturday 19:00 americano for newcomers (levels 0 to 2.5) at Kross Padel Asoke, with sangria included in the social format.

Book through the Kross Book & Go system.

title: Rajadamnern World Series (RWS) Saturday Fight Night
summary: The flagship weekly RWS muay thai card at Rajadamnern Stadium every Saturday night.
description:
Rajadamnern World Series takes over Thailand's oldest stadium every Saturday, with a card running roughly 19:00 to 22:00.

The venue hosts other promotions on other nights (Knockout, New Power, Petchyindee, Kiatpetch), so the stadium has fights most evenings. Arrive about an hour early; cards change occasionally around holidays.
address: 1 Ratchadamnoen Nok Rd, Bangkok

title: Trick or Smash Halloween Americano at Bel Club 22
summary: Halloween-night americano at Bel Club 22 for players around levels 1.2-3.9.
description:
Bel Club 22 celebrates Halloween with a themed americano on the evening of 31 October.

Sign up via Padel Mates or Playtomic.
address: 1938 New Petchaburi Road, Bangkok

title: Kangkao Halloween
summary: Kangkao's Halloween night party at DUAL in Silom, running until 4am.
description: The Kangkao crew throw their Halloween party at DUAL on 31 October, running until 4am.

title: The Haunted House: Speakerbox Halloween Takeover
summary: A full-venue Halloween rave at Speakerbox in Thonglor with more than 15 DJs.
description: Speakerbox turns the whole venue into a haunted house for Halloween night, with Sam Laxton, Sean Fortune, Kamiko and more than a dozen others across its rooms.

title: ÆTHER Halloween: MORE RICE 9th Anniversary x Red Monolith
summary: The MORE RICE crew celebrate nine years with a Halloween takeover at ÆTHER, Silom.
description: ÆTHER's Halloween night doubles as the MORE RICE 9th anniversary. DOTT, Sarayu, Wildealer, Meltmode and others play across the Silom club.

title: Zara Larsson: Midnight Sun Tour Bangkok
summary: Swedish pop star Zara Larsson plays UOB LIVE.
description: Zara Larsson brings her Midnight Sun era pop show to UOB LIVE at EmSphere for one night.
address: EmSphere, 628 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok

title: WILDER Training Club: Sunrise Yoga & HIIT in Benjakitti Park
summary: Free Sunday-morning sunrise yoga followed by a bodyweight HIIT session at Benjakitti Park.
description:
WILDER Training Club meets every Sunday at the Lakeside Stage in Benjakitti Park: check-in from 06:15, a 30-minute sunrise yoga flow at 06:30, then HIIT from 07:10.

The session is free but registration is required. Check the organiser's Instagram (@drinkWILDER) for any schedule changes.
address: 90 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110

title: Port FC vs Beijing Guoan (AFC Champions League Elite)
summary: Port host Chinese giants Beijing Guoan in the AFC Champions League Elite league stage.
description:
Port's continental home games move from PAT Stadium to a larger venue; this league-stage tie is listed at Pathum Thani Stadium.

Kick-off time was not yet published at the time of research.

title: THE STANDARD Economic Forum 2026: Reinvent Thailand
summary: A three-day forum on the global economy, AI and Thailand's future industries at Royal Paragon Hall.
description:
THE STANDARD's annual forum covers data centres, AI, autonomous vehicles, humanoid robots and Thailand's 2027 strategy, with a session reflecting on Thailand hosting the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings. Policymakers headline the Main Stage, builders take the X Stage, and there is an exhibition and networking lounge.

09:00-18:00 daily. Early-bird three-day pass B1,990 and one-day pass B790 until 3 Nov; regular prices from 4 Nov.
venue_name: Royal Paragon Hall, 5th Floor, Siam Paragon
address: 991/1 Rama 1 Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

title: BG Pathum United vs Tai Po (AFC Champions League Two)
summary: BG Pathum United host Hong Kong side Tai Po in the AFC Champions League Two group stage.
description:
The return leg against Tai Po, a week after the away game in Hong Kong. Played at BG Pathum's home ground in Pathum Thani.

Kick-off time not yet confirmed.
address: Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani

title: Thailand Baby & Kids Best Buy (November 2026)
summary: A huge free fair for parents, with 1,200+ booths of baby and children's products.
description:
This one-stop shopping fair for mums and kids fills IMPACT Challenger Hall 3 with more than 1,200 booths selling strollers, car seats, breast pumps, clothing, organic products and more, plus family activities.

Open 10:00-20:00; free admission.
address: 99 Popular Rd, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi 11120

title: Thailand Mobile Expo 2026 & AI Expo 2026
summary: One of Thailand's biggest gadget shows, with phones, computers and smart devices plus an AI expo.
description:
Global brands show and sell smartphones, tablets, computers, gadgets, accessories and smart devices, with deals throughout. This year runs alongside AI Expo 2026 in a larger space.

Open 10:00-20:00; free entry. MRT Pink Line to Muang Thong Thani.
address: 99 Popular Rd, Ban Mai, Pak Kret, Nonthaburi 11120

title: Open-Air Film Night at Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park
summary: A free open-air cinema night on the park's sloping lawn, with music and activities between screenings.
description:
The third edition of this free outdoor film festival puts a big screen on the lawn of Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park. Between films there are folk singers, bands, tarot readers and live sketch artists, plus activities on social issues.

Bring a picnic mat. The film line-up is announced on the organisers' Instagram (Chulaklangplaeng).
address: Banthat Thong Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok

title: Sustainability Expo 2026 (SX2026)
summary: ASEAN's largest sustainability exposition takes over all of QSNCC for ten days.
description:
The seventh SX, themed "Sufficiency for Sustainability", fills QSNCC with talks, panels, workshops, exhibitions, art and social-enterprise products. Zones include Better Me, Better Living, Better Community and Better World, the SX Food Festival, a Kids Zone, a marketplace and the SX Global Forum.

A good pick for families as well as professionals.
address: 60 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110

title: Ice Cold Padel Night at Sterling

Wan Dek falls on the second Saturday of January, which in 2027 is 9 January. Traditionally Government House and military bases open to families, museums offer free entry and malls run workshops and giveaways.

Specific 2027 programmes are usually announced in late December or early January; check venue pages closer to the date.

Organised by the National Jogging Association of Thailand, the 37th Bangkok Marathon takes runners past the city's landmarks. Note the date: this edition runs on Sunday 10 January 2027.

The marathon starts at 00:00, the half marathon at 03:00, the 10 km at 04:30 and the 5 km at 05:00, all on Sanam Chai Road. A separate registration stream is available for foreign runners.
